$comment: First-party game-integration repositories, by GitHub repository_id (stable across renames and transfers), and the digest-pin rule of dev/game-integrations-plan-merged.md §5.1 (c). Changing this file is a pull request to main; the catalogue never writes it.

rule.text: A first-party release is admitted without a GitHub build attestation when (1) its repository_id and repository_owner_id equal a row below, (2) the downloaded asset's SHA-256 equals GitHub's own asset digest, and (3) a row in pins[] names the same repository_id, tag and asset with that SHA-256. A release with no pin is held (H_FIRST_PARTY_UNPINNED) until the owner's release script adds one; a pin that disagrees with the bytes is refused (E_PIN_MISMATCH). Community releases always need the attestation (A§4.1).
